content_sections.heading: IISER Mohali Recruitment 2026 Walk-in Interview Date, Time and Venue
content_sections.text: The official notification does not specify the application fee, the exact amount of the monthly remuneration or the minimum educational qualification.

rows.details: Meeting Room, Administrative Block, IISER Mohali, Sector-81, S. A. S. Nagar, Punjab (140306)
Fixed monthly remuneration as per DoE guidelines, OM No. F. No. 3-25/2020-E.IIIA dated 9th December, 2020
Citizens of India retired from the IA & AD at pay level 11 and above, not more than 63 years as on date of interview

content_sections.heading: About IISER Mohali
content_sections.text: The Indian Institute of Science Education and Research (IISER) Mohali is an Institute of National Importance under the Ministry of Education, Govt. of India, located at Sector–81, Knowledge City, P O. Manauli, S.A.S. Nagar (Mohali), Punjab–140306. According to the notice, it was established by the Government of India, MoE (erstwhile MHRD) in 2007 to carry out research in frontier areas of Science and to provide quality Science Education and Research at the undergraduate and postgraduate levels.

content_sections.heading: Posts and Eligibility
content_sections.text: IISER Mohali is engaging one Internal Audit Officer/Consultant on contract basis and is looking for dedicated, committed and qualified citizens of India. The essential qualification and experience printed in the notice is: "The applicant should have retired from the IA & AD at the pay level 11 and above." The official notification does not specify the minimum educational qualification. The maximum age limit is not more than 63 years as on date of interview. The notice does not mention any age relaxation. A fixed monthly remuneration shall be admissible in accordance with the DoE guidelines published vide OM No. F. No. 3-25/2020-E.IIIA dated 9th December, 2020. The amount of remuneration so fixed shall remain unchanged for the term of the contract, and there will be no annual increment or percentage increase during the contract period. The transport allowance component will be based on the concerned guidelines of DoE and linked to the station of deployment of the Consultant. Apart from this, the selected person will not be entitled to any other allowance or incentive. Candidates should check the official notification for the full eligibility conditions of the post.

content_sections.heading: What to Bring
content_sections.text: The duly filled prescribed application form All relevant educational and experience certificates The originals of all relevant certificates, for verification One self-attested copy of the certificates, to be deposited The notice asks candidates to bring the prescribed application form but does not say where the form is available.

content_sections.heading: What Happens on the Day
content_sections.text: Report at the Meeting Room, Administrative Block, IISER Mohali by 09:30 a.m. on 17 November 2026. Only candidates reporting on time will be considered for the hiring process; those reporting after the schedule shall not be eligible to participate. Original certificates are verified, and one self-attested copy is deposited. The interview begins at 10:00 a.m.

faq.question: Q1. When is the IISER Mohali Internal Audit Officer/Consultant walk-in interview?
faq.answer: The walk-in interview is on 17 November 2026, with reporting at 09:30 a.m. and the interview at 10:00 a.m.

faq.question: Q2. Where is the IISER Mohali walk-in interview venue?
faq.answer: The venue is Meeting Room, Administrative Block, IISER Mohali, Sector-81, S. A. S. Nagar, Punjab (140306).

faq.question: Q3. How many vacancies are there for Internal Audit Officer/Consultant?
faq.answer: There is 01 post of Internal Audit Officer/Consultant under Advt. No. NF (07)/Contract/2026.

faq.question: Q4. Who is eligible for the IISER Mohali Internal Audit Officer/Consultant post?
faq.answer: The applicant should have retired from the IA & AD at the pay level 11 and above and be a citizen of India.

faq.question: Q5. What is the age limit for the post?
faq.answer: The age limit is not more than 63 years as on date of interview.

faq.question: Q6. What is the salary of the IISER Mohali Internal Audit Officer/Consultant?
faq.answer: A fixed monthly remuneration is paid in accordance with the DoE guidelines vide OM No. F. No. 3-25/2020-E.IIIA dated 9th December, 2020, and it stays unchanged for the contract term with no annual increment.

faq.question: Q7. Is any allowance paid on top of the remuneration?
faq.answer: A transport allowance component is paid as per the DoE guidelines, linked to the station of deployment; the selected person is not entitled to any other allowance or incentive.

faq.question: Q8. What documents should I bring to the walk-in?
faq.answer: Bring the duly filled prescribed application form, the originals of all relevant educational and experience certificates for verification, and one self-attested copy to be deposited.

faq.question: Q9. Is the IISER Mohali Internal Audit Officer/Consultant job permanent?
faq.answer: No, it is purely temporary on contract basis, initially for one year, and may be extended until the incumbent attains the age of 65 years, with no absorption or regularization.

faq.question: Q10. Will TA/DA be paid for attending the interview?
faq.answer: No, TA/DA shall not be admissible for attending the selection process or for joining the Institute on appointment.
